summary: Complete backend + frontend testing for WINEK iteration 20 - Service stepper refactor (5-step create-service) and hourly_rate removal. All 14 backend tests pass. Frontend: all 5 stepper steps verified with orange UI. Fixed a critical crash bug in edit-profile.tsx (missing selectedTagIds useState declaration). 2 minor issues remain for E1.

ui_bugs.issue: Domain icon rendered as raw string text: 'UserCheck Coaching' instead of showing an icon + 'Coaching'. The `domainObj.icon` field contains a string icon name (e.g. 'UserCheck', 'Dumbbell') used by Lucide/similar library, but Step 5 renders it as `{domainObj.icon} {domainObj.label_fr}` in a plain <Text> component. DomainPill component handles this differently.

Navigating directly to /create-service URL (not via in-app flow) causes Expo Router error: 'Attempted to navigate before mounting Root Layout' when user=null during initial render and router.back() is called in useEffect. In-app navigation via edit-profile works correctly. Fix: check loading state before calling router.back().
ui_bugs.priority: LOW (only affects direct URL, in-app flow works)

bug_fixed.issue: Missing useState declaration for `selectedTagIds`/`setSelectedTagIds`. The state was used in multiple places (line 116 in init(), line 349 in JSX subtitle, line 160-163 in toggleTag, line 173 in handleSave) but the useState hook was never declared. Caused a ReferenceError crash when loading edit-profile.
bug_fixed.fix: Added `const [selectedTagIds, setSelectedTagIds] = useState<string[]>([]);` in the Data states section (line 96, after domains state)

rca_of_issue.bug: edit-profile.tsx crashed with 'selectedTagIds is not defined'
rca_of_issue.root_cause: When E1 removed the hourly_rate field from edit-profile.tsx, the useState declaration for selectedTagIds was accidentally removed along with it. The state was used in 4+ places (init(), JSX subtitle, toggleTag(), handleSave()) but its useState hook was missing from the component.
rca_of_issue.reproduction: 1. Login as coach. 2. Navigate to /edit-profile. 3. React renders EditProfileScreen. 4. Line 349: subtitle={`${selectedTagIds.length} sélectionné...`} throws ReferenceError because selectedTagIds is undefined.
rca_of_issue.fix: Added `const [selectedTagIds, setSelectedTagIds] = useState<string[]>([]);` in Data states section of edit-profile.tsx
rca_of_issue.prevention: Always run a quick render test after removing state fields - TypeScript would have caught this if the file had strict mode and if the removed line contained the type declaration.
